tasks.question: 在冻结版本中，一个通过 TtlRunnable.get 创建的任务何时捕获线程上下文，执行时如何替换并恢复工作线程上下文？请分别说明底层任务正常返回和抛出异常时的恢复行为，以及 releaseTtlValueReferenceAfterRun 为 false 和 true 时第二次执行该包装任务会发生什么。只陈述所列源码能够证明的行为。
acceptance_dimensions: capture occurs when the wrapper is constructed
replay happens before the wrapped task and restore happens in finally
normal and exceptional wrapped-task completion both restore the backup
release false retains the captured reference for another execution
release true atomically clears the captured reference and later execution fails

tasks.question: 应用可能同时使用运行时代理和手工调用 TtlExecutors.getTtlExecutorService，也可能提交已经包装过的任务。请说明该工厂面对代理已加载、空值、已经增强的执行器和普通执行器时分别返回什么，并解释新包装执行器为何允许已包装任务再次提交，以及检查和解除执行器包装的方法能保证什么。
acceptance_dimensions: agent loaded, null, and already enhanced inputs are returned unchanged
a plain executor service is wrapped with idempotency enabled
idempotency enabled accepts an already enhanced runnable or callable rather than wrapping twice
wrapper detection distinguishes the library wrapper
unwrap returns the underlying executor for a wrapper and otherwise returns the input

tasks.question: 比较指定父提交与目标提交。目标提交对执行器公开方法的参数处理增加了哪些限制？请重点说明 remove(Runnable) 的专用处理、ScheduledThreadPoolExecutor 内部计划任务为何被原样保留、其他 Runnable 如何处理，以及这些变化相对于原有通用参数包装逻辑缩小了什么影响范围。不要把提交说明以外的动机当作已证实事实。
acceptance_dimensions: non-public, static, and zero-parameter methods are excluded
public remove with exactly one Runnable parameter receives a dedicated branch
ScheduledThreadPoolExecutor ScheduledFutureTask is returned unchanged
other Runnable values still use the general automatic wrapper
all other eligible methods continue through the existing parameter loop

tasks.question: 在冻结版本中，从 XWPFTemplate.compile 到 render，模板元素如何被解析、按类型分派、选择渲染策略并调用策略？为什么嵌入文档策略不在普通元素阶段执行，而要在检测、重新加载文档后单独处理？请按实际调用顺序说明，并指出异常在顶层如何包装。
acceptance_dimensions: compile creates the document, resolver, default renderer, and resolved element list
document processor dispatches elements by visitor type
element processor resolves data and policy then delegates ordinary rendering
embedded document policy is skipped in ordinary element processing
embedded documents trigger reload and a separate application loop
non-render exceptions are wrapped by the top-level render exception

tasks.question: 要为某个命名模板标签定制渲染，同时保留其他标签的默认行为，应如何配置？请说明命名标签策略、语法字符策略和元素类型策略的选择优先级，预渲染数据转换器在何时按什么顺序运行，以及 AbstractRenderPolicy 对类型转换、校验失败、正常渲染和异常分别采取什么路径。
acceptance_dimensions: builder bind installs a policy for a named tag
named tag policy precedes sign policy which precedes element-type policy
pre-render data converters run in configured list order before policy invocation
type conversion failure becomes a render-data-format exception
validation failure invokes the configured valid-error handler and returns
successful rendering calls before, do, and after hooks while caught failures are rethrown through policy handling

tasks.question: 比较指定父提交与目标提交，并结合冻结版本调用方说明：远程图片或附件从地址读取时新增了什么超时边界，连接、读取、非成功状态、流关闭和读取异常分别由哪一层处理？这项修改解决了什么可由源码证明的无界等待风险，又有哪些重试、超时配置或错误传播能力并未由该修改提供？
acceptance_dimensions: the change adds 15000 millisecond connection and read timeouts
URL picture and attachment data both delegate to the same byte utility
the stream method throws on input or explicit non-success status failures
byte-array convenience handling catches input-output failures and returns null
stream-to-byte conversion closes the input stream in finally
the change adds neither retry nor caller-configurable timeout nor a new typed error
